_readme: Standard layout: the release unzipped to C:\qa-os and C:\qa-os opened in Claude. The release already ships this as qa-os/.claude/settings.json, so nothing to do. Only if qa-os sits INSIDE another workspace folder (e.g. C:\QA\work\qa-os) and you open that parent folder: copy this file to <parent>\.claude\settings.json and change the path below to "./qa-os".
